records.body:

Reply any time.

Cheers,

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invites, no tickets, and no customer reply to either outreach (email:f6169c30, email:8dc2828f) despite a held kickoff (calendar:f79ff6f6). Team plan and kickoff attendance show intent, but zero product activity after a week suggests low unaided odds of reaching the milestone in 8 days.

draft.subject: Getting Granite Studio's first project started
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Following up on where we left off: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is usually the natural starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week \u2014 just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Priya
